metaTitle: How to Size a Solar Panel for Camping
description: Size a camping solar panel from daily watt-hours and peak sun hours, then match it to your power station or battery with worked examples and a sizing table.
directAnswer: Divide your daily watt-hours by peak sun hours (usually 3 to 5) and by about 0.7 for real-world losses. A phone and lights need 20 to 50 W, a laptop about 100 W, and a 12 V fridge setup 200 to 300 W.
